items.summary: AnalyticDB PostgreSQL Query Skill. Any AI Agent with shell execution capability can use this Skill to connect to an AnalyticDB PostgreSQL database via psql,...
items.description:
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL Query Skill. Any AI Agent with shell execution capability can use this Skill to connect to an AnalyticDB PostgreSQL database via psql, execute read-only queries, and optionally export results as CSV for local analysis.
**Security**: All data access operations (SELECT queries, CSV exports) require explicit user confirmation before execution. Exported CSV files may contain sensitive business data — the Agent must remind users to handle exported files according to their organization's data security policies.
Trigger words: query data, SQL query, export CSV, ADBPG, analyze, statistics, psql

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AnalyticDB PostgreSQL Query Skill for AI agents with shell access.
- Agents can connect to AnalyticDB PostgreSQL via psql, execute read-only queries, and export results as CSV, with explicit user confirmation required.
- Strict security gates before execution: ensures read-only mode, statement timeout, semantic model presence, and query validation.
- Enforces prohibition on accessing or exposing credential files; only `cat ~/.pg_service.conf` (excludes secrets) is permitted, never credentials.
- Human-in-the-loop is required for every query execution and export, including sensitive data or large result sets.
- No bypass allowed for security, HITL, or pre-query gates; Agents must always halt on errors or warnings for explicit user action.
